headline: RIIZE join Mexico's Tecate Pa'l Norte 2027
sub: The only K-pop act on the lineup, playing day one on Mar 26

points.title: What to know
items: RIIZE played Lollapalooza South America before
Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is up next

source: Source: Tecate Pa'l Norte official lineup announcement
caption:
RIIZE are heading to Monterrey for Tecate Pa'l Norte 2027!

Mexico's biggest music festival revealed its 15th-anniversary lineup on Nov 24, and RIIZE are the only K-pop act on it. They'll perform on day one, Mar 26, alongside headliners Travis Scott, The Neighbourhood and Caifanes at Parque Fundidora. Before that, the group joins the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade and plans a 2nd full album in Q1 2027.

📌 Source: Tecate Pa'l Norte, via Korean media (Ilgan Sports, Star News)
